error.link_settings_conflict: The device is already in use with different link settings

data_description.energy_registers: Adds read-only sensors for electrical power, cumulative energy, demand vs. supply and thermal power from input registers 34-51 (32-bit values). Not every unit serves them: a unit that does not answer simply leaves the sensors without a value, and is asked again only every few polls.
data_description.compressor_modulation_limit: Adds a slider (40-100 %) for the maximum compressor modulation, holding register 23. Not every unit serves it; while it does not answer the slider stays unavailable. Writing this register is only possible while this option is on.
data_description.experimental_registers: Adds read-only sensors for 18 registers the device answers on but the manual does not document. Nothing is ever written to them. Meant for collecting data over time.
